Originally 50 million PVTY were issued; burns can reduce supply. Provider and verifier staking, slashing, governance and settlement utility remain planned, not deployed. The public tools can be evaluated without purchasing PVTY.

KILROY WAS HERE. THE FIRST GLOBAL MEME.

Before the internet, before crypto, before the word "meme" even existed, there was Kilroy.

Born during World War II, Kilroy became the world's first global meme, appearing on walls, tanks, ships and battlefields across continents. His iconic face became a symbol of courage, hope, unity and solidarity among soldiers.
Legend has it that even Hitler believed Kilroy was an Allied spy, as his mysterious markings appeared everywhere.

Over 80 years later, Kilroy is still recognized and used around the world, appearing in street art, graffiti, monuments and popular culture.

The original global meme, spreading worldwide long before the internet existed. Now immortalized on the blockchain.
